title: Institutional settlement, pathway history, KJ3V and mixed-precision model evidence
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: historical evidence qualified; unresolved consumers and source gaps preserved
reviews.disposition: The original factory, region, civil identity, clearance, broker and pressure slices remain historical implementation records. Savant was the selected third path; Sleepless and Spectator were not thereby completed. Ordinary waiting and acting merit are different routes; three/two-day prototype scales do not prove simulated NPC waiting. One-church-per-life and pressure-six branch endings describe this prototype, not universal world laws. Grade-two clearance does not establish item custody; concealed-observer rows had no app reveal consumer. The late primary reconciliation supersedes earlier command shapes: district data and admitted job definitions stay stable, twelve walks settle arrival through the existing clock, non-Nighthawk walks use neutral prose, vouching belongs to the relevant office, and broker pressure differs from legitimate refusal. The university-quarter ID migration is exact-ID, idempotent and rejects dual identities; its old-job/browser observations are historical. Earlier factory-shape tests should not be restored as product requirements. The two passing 2671-test runs and two earlier failures cannot be collapsed into one run or diagnosed as harmless load failures without their evidence. Sixteen DOM sweeps and page screenshots do not establish panel typography or 14/21px acceptance. Hostile encounters, reveal consumption, temptation, grade-two custody, Sequence 7 and further cities remain separately unproved. No source, saved fixture or runtime was re-exercised here.

reviews.classification: historical evidence qualified; unresolved consumers and source gaps preserved
reviews.disposition: This captured conversion card qualifies O2 rather than choosing an artifact. Its 219 eight-bit and 279 four-bit entries total 498 quantized tensors, not 498 transformer blocks; the architecture description has 64 blocks. Allocation transferred from Qwen3.5-27B was not sensitivity-swept on this fine-tune. Matching tensor shapes do not establish optimal quality. The card explicitly says the six-metric evaluation was not run. Creator spot checks of arithmetic, code and explanations, plus a three-prompt style comparison, do not qualify YAIR long-context consistency, correction retention, useful planning, Mac speed or energy. Both style conditions had zero em dashes; sentence-length resemblance is a small creator comparison, not an authorship detector. The old approximate 18GB disk claim does not supersede the report's captured 18,966,599,842 shard bytes or measure resident RAM. Apache metadata on this conversion does not resolve upstream Hemmingway NC terms. Qwen3.5/Qwen3.8 lineage labels still need exact config/checkpoint/template qualification. Preserve raw card text and usage commands as source material; no installation, inference, weights hash or live benchmark was performed.

reviews.classification: historical evidence qualified; unresolved consumers and source gaps preserved
reviews.disposition: The opening queued status is superseded by this record's final frozen-branch receipt, not evidence that Q6 remained wholly unimplemented. Existing Savant/Sailor paths gained actual examination consumers rather than duplicate paths. Local pre-screen sets assessment requirements without releasing a dose; the separate senior examination releases exactly once. Current body, role, co-location and support matter at admission and settlement. Old admitted timed jobs retain their byte-stable definitions and historical releases; absent examiners are not invented on load. E1-M6 remains a real visit/appointment gap for starting new exams on such saves. Native pending-job proof found a genuine completion defect: expedition-only context omitted LOTM facts. The recorded domain-registry projection and regression repair that seam; a passing admission fixture had missed it. Seven immediate golden changes and empty-holder normalization do not license regeneration of timed definitions or ignoring nonempty means. The final branch records build/architecture/rules, 2893/2893 full tests, four pathway journeys and six persistence checkpoints on one frozen bundle. Typography setup first mislabeled 14px body text, then checked actual 14/21px panels at 1920 and 1536; retain that correction. Sailor preservation and later browser-only checks did not rerun the full suite. These are historical branch proofs with exact hashes, not fresh primary-tree proof. Integration must preserve independent primary role/vital-ledger hunks and rebuild the combined tree. Source-supported Nighthawk examination differs from authored church titles/customs. E1-M7/M8 menu/refusal-copy work and E1-M6 visits remain proposals, not dispatched or delivered. No old server, command, worker or branch authority is reactivated by this review.

reviews.classification: historical evidence qualified; unresolved consumers and source gaps preserved
reviews.disposition: The 25-act, three-scene KJ3V run records 913 added fill minutes and a bounded final native journey, not complete physical or source-mechanism coverage. One Spirit Vision tap without recovery does not prove switching or exhaustion. Four pence assembled from pennies/halfpence is not a full fractional-money journey. Firearm rounds remain a fixed authored fact even after the narrated shot; the holder remains a desk checkpoint despite pillow prose. Neither is functional ammunition/custody proof. Carriage act locations and note-only floors, rooms and text roles do not establish placed rooms or actual actors. Three relocations in this run do not diagnose or repair the earlier KJ3E freeze. Leonard's arrival/visit/end-of-walk placements have distinct states; unknown roles do not become knowledge automatically. Pending commission is not paid income, and unpriced services are not debits. The final leak scan followed an earlier false positive matching “vaults”; preserve both attempts. Crossing day eight to nine with zero selected late beats does not establish global clock/booking repair, nor explain the KJ3M reserved-beat failure. The 829.2-second journey, three boots, import/reload and zero page errors do not prove desktop font matrices, a new full suite or current build. M1–M4 were proposed, not filed. Source fidelity, real actor placement, quantities and functional firearms remain named gaps. The next chapter's unrevealed knowledge stays withheld.
